title.en: Swap tokens on Uniswap (Permit2 allowance already in place)
title.zh-TW: 用 Uniswap 兌換代幣（Permit2 授權已經有了）

summary.en: The Safe calls `execute` on Uniswap's Universal Router with a single `V4_SWAP`: in one v4 pool with no hook, it sells the amount you type, and all of the bought token goes to the Safe. The router pulls tokens from the Safe through Permit2, so the Safe must already have given allowances to Permit2 and to the router (two other templates, uniswap/approve-permit2 and uniswap/allow-router, set these two allowances and can go in the same MultiSend as this one).
summary.zh-TW: Safe 呼叫 Uniswap Universal Router 的 `execute`，裡面只有一個 `V4_SWAP`：在一個沒有 hook 的 v4 池子，把你填的數量賣掉，買進的代幣全部給 Safe。router 透過 Permit2 從 Safe 拉代幣，所以 Safe 之前要已經授權過 Permit2 和 router（另外兩個模板 uniswap/approve-permit2、uniswap/allow-router 做這兩個授權，可以和這個放在同一筆 MultiSend）。

text.en: The Safe gives exactly the amount you type and receives no less than the minimum you type. You type the minimum from what the app shows.
text.zh-TW: Safe 剛好給出你填的數量、收到不少於你填的最少數量；最少數量要你照 app 填。

intro.en: Uniswap: the largest decentralized exchange on Ethereum. All v4 pools live in one PoolManager contract.
intro.zh-TW: Uniswap：以太坊上最大的去中心化交易所；v4 的池子都在同一個 PoolManager 合約裡。

text.en: The v4 core and periphery contracts and the Universal Router all have public audit reports (OpenZeppelin, Spearbit, Certora and others), in each repo's audits folder.
text.zh-TW: v4 核心與周邊合約、Universal Router 都有公開的審計報告（OpenZeppelin、Spearbit、Certora 等），放在各 repo 的 audits 資料夾。

text.en: You type the card's "minimum to receive" yourself. The Uniswap app's trading API works out the slippage at each quote (auto slippage 0.5% to 5.5%), and the price comes from a route the API finds across many pools, which no view on chain can read.
text.zh-TW: 卡片的「最少收到的數量」要你自己填：Uniswap app 的滑價由它的交易 API 每次報價時算（自動滑價 0.5% 到 5.5%），價格來自 API 在很多池子間找的路由，鏈上沒有一個 view 讀得到。

recommendation.en: Type the minimum to receive shown on the app's confirm screen. Do not type a lower one.
recommendation.zh-TW: 照 app 確認畫面上的最少收到數量填，不要填得更低。

text.en: The app picks the pool (fee and tick spacing). The template allows any pool and only requires that it has no hook. Anyone can open a v4 pool, so the only price protection is the minimum you type: below it, the router makes the transaction fail, and verify also gives MISMATCH.
text.zh-TW: 池子（手續費和 tick 間距）由 app 選，模板不限，只要求沒有 hook。任何人都能開 v4 池子，所以價格只靠你填的最少數量保護：少於它，router 讓交易失敗，verify 也會 MISMATCH。

recommendation.en: Acceptable. Always type the minimum to receive that the app shows.
recommendation.zh-TW: 可以接受；最少收到的數量一定照 app 顯示的填。

text.en: The template accepts one shape only: one v4 pool, the swap first, then SETTLE and TAKE. When the app routes through v3, several hops, a split order, or a pool with a hook, verify gives MISMATCH; that does not mean the transaction is wrong.
text.zh-TW: 模板只接受一種形狀：一個 v4 池子、先 swap 再 SETTLE 和 TAKE。app 走 v3、多跳、拆單或有 hook 的池子時，verify 會 MISMATCH，不是交易有問題。

recommendation.en: On MISMATCH, read the cause. If the shape differs, do not sign; ask the AI to make another template for that shape.
recommendation.zh-TW: MISMATCH 時看原因；是形狀不同就不要簽，請 AI 為那種形狀另做模板。

1.execute.commands.en: The list of commands, one command per byte. 0x10 is `V4_SWAP`, one v4 swap.
1.execute.commands.zh-TW: 指令清單，每個 byte 一個指令。0x10 是 `V4_SWAP`，一次 v4 兌換。

1.execute.inputs.en: One set of parameters per command, in the same order as the command list.
1.execute.inputs.zh-TW: 每個指令一份參數，順序和指令清單一樣。

1.execute.inputs[0].en: The parameters of `V4_SWAP`: the list of v4 actions and each action's parameters.
1.execute.inputs[0].zh-TW: `V4_SWAP` 的參數：v4 動作清單和每個動作的參數。

1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.actions.en: The list of v4 actions: 0x07 `SWAP_EXACT_IN` (swap by the input amount), 0x0b `SETTLE` (pay the token sold), 0x0e `TAKE` (take the token bought).
1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.actions.zh-TW: v4 動作清單：0x07 `SWAP_EXACT_IN`（照輸入數量兌換）、0x0b `SETTLE`（付出賣的代幣）、0x0e `TAKE`（領走買到的代幣）。

1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params.en: One set of parameters for each of the three actions.

1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.en: What the swap does: what to sell, which pool it goes through, how much to sell, and the least to get.
1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.zh-TW: 兌換的內容：賣什麼、經過哪個池子、賣多少、最少要拿到多少。

1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.en: The pools it goes through, one item per pool. The template accepts only one pool.
1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.zh-TW: 經過的池子，一個池子一項；模板只接受一個池子。

1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.en: That pool: the token on the other side, the fee, the tick spacing, the hook.
1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.zh-TW: 那個池子：另一邊的代幣、手續費、tick 間距、hook。

1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.en: The token this hop swaps into, that is, the token bought.
1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.zh-TW: 這一跳換到的代幣，也就是買進的代幣。

1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.en: The pool's fee tier, set when the app picks the route. Between USDC and USDT, 7 and 8 have been seen (7 and 8 per million). Another value means another pool, or a pool that does not exist.
1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.zh-TW: 池子的手續費等級，app 選路由時決定；USDC 和 USDT 之間看過 7 和 8（百萬分之 7、8）。換成別的值就是別的池子或不存在的池子。

1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.en: The pool's tick spacing. Together with the fee, it decides which pool this is. Every one seen was 1.
1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.zh-TW: 池子的 tick 間距，和手續費一起決定是哪個池子；看過的都是 1。

1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.en: The pool's hook contract. The zero address means no hook, so no extra contract runs during the swap.
1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.zh-TW: 池子的 hook 合約；零地址代表沒有 hook，兌換時不會跑任何額外的合約。

1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.en: Data for the hook. There is no hook, so it is empty.
1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.zh-TW: 給 hook 的資料；沒有 hook，所以是空的。

1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.en: The lowest price for each hop, optional. It can only make the transaction fail when the price is too poor. It was empty in every transaction seen.
1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.zh-TW: 每一跳的最低價格，可有可無；只會讓價格太差時交易失敗。看過的交易都是空的。

1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.en: The amount to sell, in the token's base units.
1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.zh-TW: 賣出的數量，以代幣的最小單位計。

1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.en: The least amount of the bought token to get. Below this, the router makes the whole transaction fail.
1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.zh-TW: 最少要拿到的買進代幣數量；少於這個數，router 讓整筆交易失敗。

1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[1].SE.en: The token to pay to the pool, that is, the token sold.
1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[1].SE.zh-TW: 要付給池子的代幣，也就是賣出的代幣。

1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[1].SE.en: 0 means pay the full amount the swap owes, that is, `amountIn`.
1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[1].SE.zh-TW: 0 代表付清兌換欠下的全部數量，也就是 `amountIn`。

1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[1].SE.en: true means the Safe that calls the router pays; the router pulls the token from the Safe through Permit2.
1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[1].SE.zh-TW: true 代表由呼叫 router 的 Safe 付款，router 透過 Permit2 從 Safe 拉代幣。

1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[2].TA.en: The token to take, that is, the token bought.
1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[2].TA.zh-TW: 要領走的代幣，也就是買進的代幣。

1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[2].TA.en: Who receives the bought token. It must be the Safe itself.
1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[2].TA.zh-TW: 誰收到買進的代幣；必須是 Safe 自己。

1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[2].TA.en: 0 means take the full amount the swap gives.
1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[2].TA.zh-TW: 0 代表領走兌換得到的全部數量。

1.execute.deadline.en: After this time the router refuses the swap. The app sets it when it builds the transaction; in the transactions seen it was about 30 minutes ahead.
1.execute.deadline.zh-TW: 過了這個時間 router 就拒絕這筆兌換；app 建交易時設定，看過的交易大約是 30 分鐘後。

pastTxsConclusion.en: No searched swap had this one-pool shape: the Safes and EOAs found mostly sent several commands or actions in one `execute`. The shape is known from the test transactions of other Safes.
pastTxsConclusion.zh-TW: 搜到的兌換沒有一筆是這種單一池子的形狀：找到的 Safe 和 EOA 多半在一次 `execute` 裡放了好幾個指令或動作。這個形狀的依據是其他 Safe 的測試交易。
